description: One synthetic Tuesday for an operations lead: three stones, each linked to an inbox signal, a calendar commitment, its progress or blocker and one decision.

signals.subject: Launch checklist: billing migration still red
signals.summary: The staging billing migration failed its second dry run; Jordan needs a call on the launch date before the go/no-go.

signals.subject: Section 7 redlines — need an answer by Thursday
signals.summary: Brightwater asks to raise the liability cap from one to two times annual fees as a condition of renewal.

signals.subject: Platform lead finalists — both free Friday
signals.summary: Both finalists can do onsites Friday; one reference for Morgan Lee is still outstanding.

signals.subject: Vote: November offsite venue
signals.summary: A venue poll that closes next week.

stones.title: Ship the Q4 self-serve launch
stones.outcome: New customers can sign up and pay without talking to sales by October 27.

progress.summary: Signup, onboarding and pricing pages are done. Billing migration and launch email remain.

blocker.summary: The billing migration failed its second staging dry run.

decision.question: Hold October 27, or move the launch one week?

options.label: Hold October 27
options.consequence: Ship with manual invoicing as a fallback while billing is fixed.

options.label: Move to November 3
options.consequence: Gives billing a third dry run; the launch email moves too.

pebbles.title: Schedule a third billing dry run

sand.title: Thank Jordan for the early warning

dialogue.briefing: Launch is your top stone. Jordan's 07:42 email says billing failed its second dry run, and the go/no-go is at 11:30. You need to choose: hold October 27 or move a week.

suggestions.prompt: What changes if we move a week?
suggestions.reply: Moving to November 3 gives billing a third dry run, and the launch email moves with it. Holding October 27 means shipping with manual invoicing until billing passes. Either way the decision is yours at 11:30.

suggestions.prompt: What should I bring to the go/no-go?
suggestions.reply: Bring the two failed dry-run results, Jordan's estimate for a fix and the manual-invoicing fallback. The fallback is still a pebble with no draft yet.

stones.title: Renew the Brightwater Co-op contract
stones.outcome: A signed two-year renewal before the October 31 expiry.

progress.summary: Pricing and term length are agreed. Liability terms and signature remain.

blocker.summary: Legal has not reviewed the two-times liability cap.

decision.question: Accept the two-times liability cap, or counter at one and a half?

options.label: Accept two times
options.consequence: Likely closes the renewal this week; needs Dana's sign-off.

options.label: Counter at one and a half times
options.consequence: Keeps exposure lower; adds at least one more round.

pebbles.title: Send section 7 to Dana for review
Prepare a pricing fallback for the 14:00 review

sand.title: Tell Priya you will answer by Thursday

dialogue.briefing: Brightwater wants a two-times liability cap before renewing. Their contract review is at 14:00 and Priya asked for an answer by Thursday. Dana has not reviewed the cap yet.

suggestions.reply: A draft you could send: "Thanks, Priya. We're reviewing section 7 with legal and will answer by Thursday. Happy to walk through it at 14:00." Nothing has been sent.
Accepting raises exposure but likely closes this week. Countering keeps exposure lower but adds a round, with the contract expiring October 31. Dana's review should come before either.

stones.title: Hire a platform engineering lead
stones.outcome: An accepted offer before the end of October.

progress.summary: Screens and panel interviews are done for both finalists. Onsites and the offer remain.

blocker.summary: One reference for Morgan Lee is outstanding.

decision.question: Bring both finalists onsite Friday, or only Morgan?

options.label: Both finalists
options.consequence: A direct comparison; Friday's schedule fills up.

options.label: Only Morgan
options.consequence: A faster path to an offer, pending the last reference.

sand.title: Ask Sam for panel notes before 16:30

dialogue.briefing: Both platform lead finalists can come onsite Friday. Morgan's last reference is outstanding. The debrief is at 16:30, where you decide who comes onsite.

suggestions.reply: Both passed screens and panel interviews. Morgan's references are pending one; the other finalist's are complete. Panel notes are with Sam and are not in this view.
